regime_context: China A-shares are in a near one-narrative state: Banks (512800.SS) are the sole eligible theme with strong absolute trend (durability 0.79, breadth 0.67), but the rotation breadth is extremely narrow (1 of 22 eligible) and the gate did NOT hold on this market's history — it whipsaws — so trend discipline here is experimental. Backtest says cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is weak, rotation timing has no edge, and the only validated edge (trend-gate drawdown avoidance) doesn't hold on this tape. Track record (dir accuracy 0.337) is well below coin-flip on direction, so all directional leans must be low conviction and conditional.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Banks' breadth (currently 0.667) falls below 0.4 while Coal's durability_bar rises above 0.6 — that combination would hint the leadership handoff is confirmed rather than just a challenger rank, and would retire the current Banks-only eligible structure.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only eligible theme with a strong absolute-trend tag (durability_bar 0.79, hurst_tag 'trend') and the best breadth (0.667), making them the dominant leadership. This is a trend-following lean on the ONLY leg with a clear (if locally unvalidated) trend signal, not a momentum bet. Crowding z=1.68 is a size-down caution, not a reason to avoid direction here.
evidence: eligible=true, only theme passing the absolute-trend gate
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting tape whipsaws the trend gate (gate_helps=false), so the one eligible trend may be just the latest unsustained move in a market that historically reverts; crowding z=1.68 marks late-stage attention.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal sits at rank 2 on momentum but is not eligible (mean-revert hurst_tag, durability_bar 0.22), thin breadth (0.3), and the rotation margin over the challenger is not confirmed by any validated handoff signal. The detector explicitly says no next-theme prediction — Coal is the nearest challenger but its glass is not durable, so the cleanest lean is to avoid active weight until a confirmed handoff shows.
evidence: durability_bar 0.22, well below the trend line
theses.dissent: Coal is the lone challenger within striking distance (score 0.955 vs Banks 1.093) and the gate's whipsaw history means the eligibility flag itself may be unreliable here.

falsifier.text: Coal (515220.SS) leads Banks by 3% and Coal's durability_bar rises above 0.6 before the 15-day check-by date

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors (512760.SS) show negative momentum (score -0.138), zero breadth, hurst 'trend' but below gate, and no crowding — a neutral-to-weak state with no edge signal. Macro narrative is AI-tech heavy (coincident, unscheduled share 1.0), but this is NOT a per-theme trigger and there's no trend leg supporting a long here in the detector.
evidence: macro ai_tech dominant is coincident, not a trigger
theses.dissent: AI-tech macro narrative (10 of 26 headlines, unscheduled) could spark a sentiment-driven re-rating with no trend preamble; in a mean-reverting tape, the negative score may mark entry rather than exit.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors (512760.SS) outperforms CSI 300 by 5% with durability_bar above 0.5 and breadth above 0.3 before the 20-day check-by date
